current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the given list L of 45 distinct positive integers can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for every triple i in {1, ..., 15}.
IF a valid partition exists, PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition, listing each triple.
INCLUDE only the partition; do not perform any additional analysis or commentary.

current_plan.body:
GENERATE all possible triples (a, b, c) from the list L where a + b = c
BUILD a graph representation linking numbers to triples they can belong to
APPLY a backtracking search to select 15 disjoint triples covering all 45 numbers
IF a complete covering set is found THEN OUTPUT the selected triples as the partition
ELSE REPORT that no valid partition exists

pending_input.description: Python code to generate and solve the partition problem for the given list L, outputting a valid partition or reporting
